title: Hourglass Reboot
author: AmuroRay
desc:
Build consistency with a focused 10-week program designed for two training days each week.  
The manageable schedule makes it easier to fit training into a busy routine while staying on track.  
Follow the plan week by week and make each session count.  
Program details are limited, so review the workouts before starting.
